_README: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy this file to 'secrets.local.json' and put your real values there. secrets.local.json is gitignored (never committed, never shared) and the assistant will not read it. The server loads secrets.local.json at runtime if it exists.

livewire._note: Mill-challan SQL Server (read-only). Fill when we build the integration.

plc._note: PLC live data — MySQL/MariaDB (read-only). The server polls each machine's plcTable every 10s. Set each machine's 'PLC table' in Admin -> Machines (e.g. jet_mch_1_rtd). Requires: pip install pymysql --break-system-packages. Temperature tolerance is set in Settings.

_gmail_note: For challan_watch.py. Use a Gmail APP PASSWORD (Account -> Security -> 2-step verification -> App passwords), NOT the normal password. The SERVER now checks email automatically every gmailPollHours hours (default 2; set 0 to turn that off and use Task Scheduler instead). It reads mail from the last gmailSinceDays days (read or unread) and never imports the same PDF twice. gmailFromFilter is optional (only read mail from that sender). For a big first-time catch-up, raise gmailSinceDays temporarily.

gemini._note: Handwriting reader for the Batch planner's camera-scan feature (QR code -> phone photographs a register -> read here -> review -> punch batches). This is the ONE deliberate outbound-internet call this app makes (everything else is LAN-only) — the register photos are sent to Google's Gemini API. Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave apiKey blank to disable the feature. See SCAN_SETUP.md. IMPORTANT: 'model' must be a name Google currently serves for your key — these get renamed/retired over time (e.g. gemini-2.0-flash has since been superseded). If a scan fails with 'Gemini API error 404', the model name is stale — check https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models and update this value. No restart needed: secrets.local.json is re-read on every scan.

backup._note: Optional: a second location to copy backups to (external drive / network share / cloud folder).

notes: Do NOT store the ERP login passwords here — those are hashed inside the database already. This file is for external system credentials and infrastructure keys only.
